proof_body:
by
  intro y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ c₁ c₂ t₀ h₁ h₂ hW h0
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t => c₁ * y₁ t + c₂ * y₂ t) (c₁ * v₁ t₀ + c₂ * v₂ t₀) t₀ :=
    (h₁.const_mul c₁).add (h₂.const_mul c₂)
  have hz : (fun t => c₁ * y₁ t + c₂ * y₂ t) = fun _ => 0 := funext h0
  rw [hz] at hd
  have hv : c₁ * v₁ t₀ + c₂ * v₂ t₀ = 0 := hd.unique (hasDerivAt_const t₀ 0)
  have hy := h0 t₀
  constructor
  · have h : c₁ * (y₁ t₀ * v₂ t₀ - v₁ t₀ * y₂ t₀) = 0 := by
      linear_combination v₂ t₀ * hy - y₂ t₀ * hv
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right hW
  · have h : c₂ * (y₁ t₀ * v₂ t₀ - v₁ t₀ * y₂ t₀) = 0 := by
      linear_combination y₁ t₀ * hv - v₁ t₀ * hy
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right hW
target_source: ∀ (y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (c₁ c₂ t₀ : ℝ), HasDerivAt y₁ (v₁ t₀) t₀ → HasDerivAt y₂ (v₂ t₀) t₀ → y₁ t₀ * v₂ t₀ - v₁ t₀ * y₂ t₀ ≠ 0 → (∀ t, c₁ * y₁ t + c₂ * y₂ t = 0) → c₁ = 0 ∧ c₂ = 0
